home.title: Olivin
home.description: A jewellery store. The catalogue, cart and checkout will arrive in later steps.

health.heading: Backend status
health.error: The backend is not responding. Start it and refresh the page.

login.title: Sign in
login.description: Sign in to your Olivin account to manage your profile and orders.

loginCode.title: Sign in with a code
loginCode.description: Enter your email address and we will send you a one-time sign-in code.
loginCode.requestFailed: Could not send the sign-in code. Try again.
loginCode.confirmTitle: Enter the code from the email
loginCode.confirmDescription: We sent a one-time code to the email address you provided. Enter it below.

register.title: Create an account
register.description: Create your Olivin account. We will send a confirmation code to the email address you provide.
register.usernameHint: 3–30 characters: letters, digits, dot, hyphen or underscore.
register.consentTerms: I accept the terms of service.
register.consentMarketing: I want to receive marketing information by email (optional).

verifyEmail.title: Confirm your email
verifyEmail.description: We sent a confirmation code to the address you used during registration. Enter it below.
verifyEmail.success: Email confirmed. Your account is ready.

passwordReset.title: Recover your password
passwordReset.description: Enter the email address of your account. We will send you a code to set a new password.
passwordReset.requestFailed: Could not send the reset code. Try again.
passwordReset.confirmDescription: Enter the code from the email and your new password.

errors.emailTaken: An account with this email address already exists.
errors.usernameInvalid: A username can contain letters, digits, dots, hyphens and underscores (3–30 characters).
errors.passwordTooShort: The password must be at least 8 characters long.
errors.passwordInvalid: The password does not meet the security requirements.
errors.consentRequired: Accept the terms of service and the privacy policy.
errors.codeRequired: Enter the code from the email.
errors.codeInvalid: The code is invalid or has expired.
errors.tooManyAttempts: Too many attempts. Wait a moment.
errors.mfaUnsupported: This account uses two-step sign-in, which the website does not support yet.
errors.registrationFailed: Could not create the account. Try again.
errors.verificationFailed: Could not confirm the email. Try again.
errors.generic: Could not sign in. Try again.
